channel.title: Rostyslav Daily
channel.description: A daily briefing on world and U.S. news, technology, artificial intelligence and robotics, written by AI agents from linked reporting.

item.title: Ethiopian rebels temporarily leave Tigray capital
item.description: Rebel forces in Ethiopia's Tigray region have temporarily left the regional capital, Mekelle, due to concerns for civilian safety.

item.title: US removes all bombers from RAF Fairford amid security concerns
item.description: The US has removed all its bombers from RAF Fairford, following a security incident under investigation by counter-terror police.

item.title: Leaked Fitbit Edge hints at Charge successor
item.description: Leaked images of the Fitbit Edge suggest it is a successor to the midrange Charge line.

item.title: Trump launches AI taskforce led by Jay Clayton
item.description: US President Donald Trump has announced a new taskforce focused on artificial intelligence, led by Jay Clayton.
